name: jobhunt-inbox
description: 收转发来的招聘邮件：拆信 → 解析引擎（规则 + 模型）→ 存进 D1；同一个程序也托管你的私人看板（登录后才能看）。跑在 Cloudflare Workers 上。

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p board && vitest run && vite build
scripts.db:recent: wrangler d1 execute jobhunt-inbox --remote --command "SELECT stored_at, status, from_addr, subject, error FROM emails ORDER BY stored_at DESC LIMIT 10"
scripts.db:notices: wrangler d1 execute jobhunt-inbox --remote --command "SELECT received_at, subject, body FROM notices ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 5"
scripts.db:parsed: wrangler d1 execute jobhunt-inbox --remote --command "SELECT subject, status, via, model, error, json_extract(outcome, '\$.trace.extraction.companyRaw') AS company, json_extract(outcome, '\$.event.eventType') AS type, json_extract(outcome, '\$.trace.format.format') AS format, json_extract(outcome, '\$.event.dueType') AS due, json_extract(outcome, '\$.event.startUtc') AS start_utc, json_extract(outcome, '\$.event.sourceTimeZone') AS tz, json_extract(outcome, '\$.event.confidence') AS confidence FROM emails ORDER BY stored_at DESC LIMIT 5"
scripts.db:why: wrangler d1 execute jobhunt-inbox --remote --command "SELECT subject, from_addr, received_at, json_extract(outcome, '\$.trace.extraction.timeText') AS model_time_text, json_extract(outcome, '\$.trace.due.reason') AS time_reason, json_extract(outcome, '\$.trace.tz.reason') AS tz_reason, json_extract(outcome, '\$.trace.confidenceReasons') AS why_pending, length(body) AS body_chars FROM emails ORDER BY stored_at DESC LIMIT 5"
scripts.db:review: wrangler d1 execute jobhunt-inbox --remote --command "SELECT substr(received_at, 1, 16) AS received, status, substr(from_addr, 1, 36) AS sender, substr(subject, 1, 40) AS subject, json_extract(outcome, '\$.event.eventType') AS type, json_extract(outcome, '\$.event.confidence') AS conf, coalesce(json_extract(outcome, '\$.reason'), json_extract(outcome, '\$.trace.prefilter.reason')) AS why FROM emails ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 40"
